result.title: Beyond Binary Correctness: A Surrogate for Confidence Learning in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) aims to assess how likely a particular generated response is to be correct. We investigate how learning this assessment can benefit from the model's predictive reliability on the underlying query. Binary correctness supervision, however, assigns identical labels to occasional errors and frequent failures, as well as isolated successes and consistent success. These outcomes can arise from substantially different predictive behavior under stochastic decoding. We propose a confidence-learning framework that supplements realized response correctness with query-level predictive reliability. We estimate reliability through repeated generations under a fixed model and decoding configuration, then combine the empirical success rate with individual correctness to construct a graded confidence surrogate. The surrogate differentiates responses sharing the same correctness label while preserving the average predictive reliability of the sampled response pool. To learn this target, we condition an independent confidence estimator on the query and its full generated response, and optimize backbone LoRA adapters together with a projection and scalar confidence head using mean squared error. Repeated sampling is required only for supervision construction; inference scores an individual response without additional generations. We establish ordering and mean preservation properties of the surrogate and derive a selective-risk bound connecting population surrogate prediction error to the error rate among accepted responses. We evaluate the framework across language and vision-language models, examining confidence calibration and selective prediction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出置信度学习框架：在固定模型与解码配置下重复生成，用经验成功率与单条回答正确性结合，构造分级置信度代理目标，训练以查询和完整回答为条件的独立置信度估计器（LoRA、投影与标量头，MSE 优化），并给出保序与均值保持性质及选择性风险界，在语言与视觉语言模型上评估校准与选择性预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，但其用重复采样构造分级监督信号、并以选择性风险刻画「何时接受某条输出」的思路，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹或分支的贡献分配与 STOP 判据设计。
